title: Buchenweg, Münster
description:
Welcome to our cozy and bright apartment, located in a quiet neighborhood close to the University Hospital in Münster! With 25 sqm of space, this apartment is perfect for solo travelers or couples who value comfort and tranquility.

The apartment is beautifully designed to maximize natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. It features all the amenities you need to feel at home, including a fully equipped kitchenette, a comfortable bed, a bathroom, and a spacious desk to work from. A couch as well as a separate table for dining are also ready. In the hallway there is storage space for things, as well as a large mirror. 

Located in a peaceful area, you can always retreat and relax after a long day. The University Hospital is just a short ride away, making it an ideal location for medical professionals, researchers, or patients.

Book your stay today and experience the best of Münster from the comfort of this cozy apartment!

title: Buchenweg, Münster
description:
Comfortable 56 m2 Flat with Balcony, Close to Uniklinik Münster

Welcome to Münster! This 56 m2 flat, located in a peaceful residential neighborhood, is perfect for students, interns, or professionals looking for a quiet and convenient place to live. Situated just a short ride away from Uniklinik Münster, this flat offers a great combination of comfort and accessibility.

Room Features:
Size: 56 m2, ideal for 1-3 people
Balcony: Enjoy your own private outdoor space with a balcony.
Kitchen: Fully functional kitchen with an oven, stove, and a large fridge for all your cooking needs.
Furniture: The flat comes fully furnished, including a comfortable bed and other essential furnishings.
Additional Information:
Public Transport: Good connections to public transportation
Laundry Facilities: There is a shared  washing machine and dryer available in the building
Neighborhood: Local supermarkets and other amenities are within walking distance

The flat is well-lit and easy to maintain, making it an ideal choice for those with a busy schedule. If you are looking for a simple, affordable place to stay in a peaceful setting close to Uniklinik Münster, this could be the perfect fit for you!

title: Isolde-Kurz- Straße, Münster
description:
This fully furnished 1-room apartment offers everything a single person or student needs within approximately 15 m2. Equipped with a bed (90x200 cm), a functional kitchenette & spacious working table it is a practical choice for singles or students looking for an economical living solution.

The area provides access to everyday essentials:
Grocery shopping is convenient with EDEKA just 5 minutes away.
Bakery Hosselmann offers fresh bread and pastries nearby.
A DHL parcel locker is available within walking distance for 24/7 package pickups.
Public transportation options and ample parking make commuting easy.

Located in a student housing complex in the quiet and green district of Münster Nienberge, this apartment provides a good balance between tranquility and accessibility. Münster Nienberge is known for its scenic surroundings and historic charm, including landmarks like Haus Rüschhaus, the former residence of poet Annette von Droste-Hülshoff. Despite its serene setting, it offers very good public transport connections via bus lines 5, N85, and regional buses R72 and R73, ensuring easy access to Münster's city center and universities. 

Apartment Features:
Living area: approx. 15 m2
1 room with a kitchenette
Fully furnished, including a bed (90x200 cm)
Ideal for singles or students
Quiet location with great public transport connections

title: Boeselagerstraße, Münster
description:
Charmante 2-Zimmer-Wohnung: Stilvoll möbliert, perfekt ausgestattet und bereit für Ihren neuen Alltag!

Willkommen in Ihrem neuen Zuhause! Diese exquisit eingerichtete 2-Zimmer-Wohnung bietet ein perfektes Gleichgewicht zwischen Stil und Komfort. Genießen Sie den modernen Lebensstil in einem geschmackvollen Ambiente.

Die geräumige und lichtdurchflutete Wohnzimmer-Oase lädt zum Entspannen und Verweilen ein. Die voll ausgestattete Küche ist nicht nur funktional, sondern auch ein Ort der Inspiration für kulinarische Kreationen.

Das gemütliche Schlafzimmer bietet Ruhe und Erholung, während das moderne Badezimmer mit einer eleganten Note Ihren Morgen belebt. Mit hochwertigen Möbeln und geschmackvollen Details ist diese Wohnung bereit, Ihren persönlichen Lebensstil zu ergänzen.

Die zentrale Lage ermöglicht eine bequeme Anbindung an öffentliche Verkehrsmittel und bietet gleichzeitig eine ruhige Nachbarschaft. In unmittelbarer Nähe finden Sie Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Restaurants und Parks, um Ihren Alltag zu bereichern.

Die Miete beinhaltet alle Nebenkosten, sowie WLAN und Kabelanschluss. Diese Wohnung ist ideal für Berufstätige, Studenten oder Paare, die auf der Suche nach einem stilvollen und komfortablen Zuhause sind.

Nehmen Sie Kontakt auf, um diese einzigartige Gelegenheit nicht zu verpassen. Ihr neues Kapitel beginnt hier!
